title: Zesty Tunisian Fish Wrap
description: A herbal, springy Tunisian dish that uses pitted black olives and fresh herbs to create a hangover cure wrapped in corn husks.
instructions: Soak corn husks in hot water for 5 minutes until pliable and set aside.
In a bowl, combine chopped olives, parsley, cilantro, cumin, paprika, chili flakes, salt, pepper, then drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice and mix well.
Pat the fish fillets dry and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Place a fillet on each softened husk, top with the herb and olive mixture, and roll the husks tightly around the fish.
Secure the wraps with a small piece of foil or kitchen twine to keep them closed.
Preheat a grill or skillet over medium heat and cook the wraps for 4 to 5 minutes per side, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Remove the foil or twine and let the wraps rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve the wraps hot, optionally with a side of fresh tomato salsa or a squeeze of lemon.
